# 2026 Elections

There are 3 elections being held in Jersey on **7th June 2026**.

- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026#e50)**

  9 seats · 14 candidates
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026#e51)**

  28 seats · 41 candidates
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026#e52)**

  12 seats · 20 candidates

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

Visit **[DigitalStates.je](https://digitalstates.je/)**

Visit **[StatesAssembly.je](https://statesassembly.je/)**

Visit **[Gov.je](https://gov.je/)**

Last updated: 23/04/26
